mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing Augustine and Luther through the same meal was most worthwhile: it showed how their questions differ without treating their accounts as identical.

leastWorthwhile.text: The fasting comparison was the most predictable: fasting plainly does not prepare supper, although the distinction between discipline and service was useful.
